note: Series that are widely correlated with bitcoin cycles, published raw so the page can test the claim rather than draw the overlay. Not carried and why: ISM manufacturing PMI is proprietary (ISM / S&P Global) with no free primary feed since FRED dropped it in 2016; 'global M2' is an author-specific blend of central-bank aggregates in dollars with no single public definition, so US M2 is published and the blend is not. Provenance: fed_funds_daily = FRED DFF: effective federal funds rate, % (daily); treasury_2y = FRED DGS2: 2-year Treasury yield, % (daily); m2_monthly = FRED M2SL: US M2 money stock, $bn, monthly, seasonally adjusted; fed_assets_weekly = FRED WALCL: Fed total assets, $mn, weekly (Wednesday); tga_weekly = FRED WTREGEN: Treasury General Account, $bn, weekly (Wednesday); rrp_daily = FRED RRPONTSYD: overnight reverse repo, $bn, daily; hy_spread_daily = FRED BAMLH0A0HYM2: ICE BofA US high-yield option-adjusted spread, % (daily); vix_daily = FRED VIXCLS: CBOE VIX close (daily); breakeven_10y_daily = FRED T10YIE: 10-year breakeven inflation, % (daily)
